newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia - De Beers talks not on hold - source.
newsitem.headline: Russia - De Beers talks not on hold - source.

text.p: Talks between Russia and De Beers on a new diamond export deal are continuing at working group level but a De Beers source on Monday was unable to say when high-level negotiations would resume.
"There are a number of us involved in this process... Nothing is on hold," said a De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd source. The latest round of talks began September 3.

The source added that talks between working groups of De Beers and Almazy Rossii-Sakha (ARS, or Diamonds of Russia), Russia's largest diamond producer and sole authorised exporter, were continuing on a new three-year diamond export deal.
Asked if the next top-level negotiations had been scheduled, the source replied, "We have no date at the moment."
Officials of ARS and De Beers will shortly fly to the Sakha Republic, or Yakutia, for independent meetings, the source said.
The source said export discussions between De Beers and ARS were going well.

"Things are moving ahead in the right direction in terms of the memorandum we signed in February," the source said, referring to an interim agreement which gives De Beers selling rights for one half of Russia's rough diamond output.
